name: School of Corentyn Armada

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text:
The Corentyn armada is well-known for their fierceness in battle, a reputation owed in large part to their naval wizards, each an expert in both tactics and torrential magic. Many such wizards are assigned to a ship in the armada, and they often take an apprentice along with them for the sea voyage.

Curriculum
- cantrips: Message, Spout

- 1st: Gust of Wind, Hydraulic Push, Rude Awakening

- 2nd: Water Breathing, Water Walk

- 3rd: aquatic arsenal, Crashing Wave

- 4th: Ice Storm, Telepathy

- 5th: Control Water, Searing Rain

- 6th: Chain Lightning, Truesight

- 7th: Energy Aegis, Project Image

- 8th: Arctic Rift, Desiccate

- 9th: Wrathful Storm

School Spells initial: Control Currents; advanced: Choking Fog
